subject: Mythology
title: Why Mesoamerican Myths Still Matter
description: A 60-second lesson on Why Mesoamerican Myths Still Matter.

hook.text: Mesoamerican myths were nearly destroyed by conquest. Their survival is one of the great stories of cultural resilience.

buildup.text: They gave the world chocolate, corn, the concept of zero, and some of the most complex calendars ever created.

discovery.text: Their creation stories ask the same questions as Greek and Hindu myths: why are we here, and what do we owe?

twist.text: For centuries, Western education ignored these myths. Now universities worldwide are finally teaching them as equals.

climax.text: Understanding these myths means understanding the foundation of Latin American culture and over 500 million people.

punchline.text: The myths they tried to burn are now taught in the universities they built.

quiz.question: Why are Mesoamerican myths increasingly taught in universities worldwide?
options: They contain practical farming techniques still used today
They are foundational to understanding Latin American culture and 500 million people
They predicted modern scientific discoveries with perfect accuracy
